onset.Description: Onset of the video measured from the beginning of the EEG recording.

duration.Description: Duration of the video (measured from onset) in seconds.

trial_num.Description: Number of each trial within a run, in the range [1, 66].

stim_id.Description: Index indicating the number ID of the presented video. Stimuli with stim_id in the range [1, 1000] belong to the training split, and stimuli with stim_id in the range [1001, 1102] belong to the test split.

is_task.Description: Whether the trial required an active behavioral response
